title: A closing brace is moved onto a line of its own only where it already opens one.
text: `brace.rs` decides the run before an *opening* brace and the one before an `elseif`, `else`, `catch` or `finally`; a `}` sharing a line with the statement before it stays there, which is the half of `rule:tooling/fmt-base-style-is-per`'s brace paragraph that needs one-statement-per-line to land with it.
